amanda_sales: Heads-up: Prospect 'ClearLedger' wants a 3-week POC to move off VendorX. Main asks: prompt/response parity, header compatibility, per-tenant billing, SSO+BYOK, and a security questionnaire. Kickoff Fri 9am PT.

ria_eng: I can run parity tests. Do we have VendorX sample payloads and any post-processing they apply?

carlos_se: Ask them for exact request headers; we've seen X-Vendor-Phase and X-Mod-Filter affect outputs. If they relied on those we'll need a mapping layer.

mina_ml: Metrics plan: entity-extraction recall for required fields (acct_id, txn_ref), BLEU, and token-length distributions. Also temperature sweep 0/0.3/0.8.

ben_sre: For 1M req/day @128 tokens = 128M tokens/day. If they want p99 <200ms recommend Dedicated reserve; hosted cost would be tokens + concurrency premium. I'll post ballpark numbers to the sheet.

secbot: Quick check: SAML SSO yes (Okta/Azure), BYOK via AWS KMS/GCP KMS or customer HSM supported, SOC2 artifacts available. See #sec-artifacts for links.

tara_legal: They'll want EU-only residency for PII and a 6-month data deletion SLA. I'll prepare DP addendum + subprocessors list.

amanda_sales: Action items: 1) @ria_eng build harness & run baseline by Tue. 2) @ben_sre estimate cost bands + provision staging key + IP allowlist. 3) @secbot attach audit docs & BYOK steps. 4) @tara_legal draft SoW + DP addendum.

carlos_se: One practical note: replicate streaming framing. VendorX sometimes sends partial tokens then final newline; our streaming uses framed JSON deltas. We'll capture both.

mina_ml: If they care about deterministic seeds, test both seeded runs and sampling variance. I'll prepare a small eval notebook.

amanda_sales: OK meeting invite sent for Fri 9am PT. Please bring any quick demos. :thumbsup:
